attempts.summary: Created "Fleet Internal CA" on node1 (OpenSSL, 4096-bit RSA, 10yr self-signed CN=Fleet Internal CA), issued a 2048-bit RSA TLS cert for node2 (CN=node2, SAN DNS:node2/IP:10.100.223.11, signed by the CA), deployed key+cert to node2 and configured nginx on port 8443 with an opened firewalld port. Installed the CA as a trusted system anchor via update-ca-trust on both node1 and node2, confirmed via `trust list` and unqualified curl (no --cacert) returning HTTP 200 both locally on node2 and remotely from node1. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured healthy baselines (boot_id, CA/cert files, trust anchors, nginx active, HTTPS 200) on both nodes, rebooted node1 then node2 one at a time via `systemctl reboot`, polled each until exec access returned, proved boot_id changed on both (node1: fb2aa416→200e77fb; node2: bccb87ac→7052aa67), and verified full post-reboot recovery (CA files/trust intact on node1, nginx auto-started with cert/firewall config intact on node2, and end-to-end HTTPS validation still succeeding from node1 to node2 after both reboots).
